description: The file defines the class EventJavaCodeProducer, which extends EventCodeProducer and is responsible for generating Java source code files related to 'Events' within the project. It creates Java classes, interfaces, and auxiliary code such as event adapters and listeners based on aggregated templates and wrappers, primarily for event handling in an SDK context.

classes.name: EventJavaCodeProducer
classes.description: A code generator class that produces Java source files for event definitions, including enums, event classes, listeners, and adapters, based on processing wrappers and templates.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Main method to trigger generation of all related Java code files for events, enums, and POJOs based on processed wrappers.

methods.name: generateWrapperFile
methods.description: Generates a Java source file for a specific wrapper (event or enum), including related listener and adapter files if applicable.

methods.name: generateWrapperBuffer
methods.description: Creates the content buffer for a Java class corresponding to a wrapper, customizing based on whether it's an event or enum.

methods.name: getEventCodesInterfaceName
methods.description: Constructs the interface name for event codes, either fully qualified or simple.

methods.name: createEventCodesFile
methods.description: Produces the Java file containing event code constants and definitions.

methods.name: createEventListenerFile
methods.description: Creates a Java listener class for a specific event wrapper.

methods.name: createEventAdapterFile
methods.description: Creates a Java adapter class for a specific event wrapper, handling decoding and support checks.

methods.name: formatEventCodes
methods.description: Formats a list of event code definitions into Java source code blocks.

methods.name: assignNames
methods.description: Assigns class, package, and filename names to the wrapper's Java context if not already set.
